description: A district director of curriculum and instruction must approve the implementation plan for a new middle-school civic media-literacy curriculum, including lesson pacing, student production rules, digital storage, and family-language access, with input from a social studies teacher, a library media specialist, and a multilingual learner coordinator.

shared_context.S1: The district is preparing to adopt the Civic Lens media-literacy curriculum for middle-school social studies classes next semester.
shared_context.S2: The current implementation draft provides eight lessons, has students make individual podcasts, uses the vendor's online workspace for student files, and supplies family materials in English only.
shared_context.S3: Dr. Morgan Lee has authority to approve the implementation plan and its operating conditions.
shared_context.S4: Under the district's curriculum-adoption protocol, the director reviews the plan in a meeting with the classroom teacher, library media specialist, and multilingual learner coordinator before issuing approval.

PF1.text: During her classroom pilot, Ms. Shah found that the curriculum requires exactly ten class lessons and that the podcast task works only when students record in pairs; she completed the pilot this week but has not updated the implementation draft.

PF2.text: Mr. Grant reviewed the executed vendor license and confirmed that student files may be stored only in the district LMS, with no uploads to the vendor workspace; the signed license is in the procurement file but has not been attached to the curriculum plan.

PF3.text: Ms. Alvarez's family review confirmed that take-home materials must be provided in English, Spanish, and Somali, and that every lesson must include teacher-provided oral directions for multilingual learners; she finished the review yesterday but has not entered the results in the adoption tracker.

acceptance_conditions: The implementation must provide exactly ten lessons.
Students must produce podcasts in pairs.
Student files must be stored in the district LMS.
Uploads to the vendor workspace must be prohibited.
Family materials must be provided in English, Spanish, and Somali.
Teacher-provided oral directions must be required.
A curriculum implementation commitment must be recorded.
A license-compliance commitment must be recorded.
A language-access commitment must be recorded.
The family-language requirement must be explicitly cited.

decisive_facts.why: The classroom pilot changes the plan from eight lessons to exactly ten and from individual podcasts to pairs.
The executed license changes storage from the vendor workspace to the district LMS and changes vendor uploads from allowed to prohibited.
The family review changes the language set to exactly English, Spanish, and Somali and adds the required oral-directions condition, language-access commitment, and citation.
